title: 介词的基础搭配（时间in/on/at，地点in/on/at）
knowledgePoint: 时间介词in/on/at的核心搭配（年/月/日/时刻/时间段）、地点介词in/on/at的用法区别（大地点/小地点/表面/范围）、固定搭配中的介词应用、易混淆介词的语境适配

questions.question: The international conference will be held ______ March 15th ______ 9:30 a.m. ______ the main hall of the city convention center.
questions.explanation: 具体日期（March 15th）前用on；具体时刻（9:30 a.m.）前用at；大地点/空间内部（the main hall）前用in，符合时间和地点介词的搭配规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 时间介词口诀：年季月周前用in，具体日期用on，时刻之前用at；地点介词口诀：大地点用in，小地点用at，表面之上用on。

questions.question: She was born in 1998, on May, and her first day at school was at September 1st, 2004.
questions.explanation: 月份（May）前用in，不能用on；具体日期（September 1st）前用on，不能用at，题干存在两处介词搭配错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 单独的月份、季节、年份前均用in（如in June/in summer/in 2023），具体“月+日”或“年+月+日”前用on。

questions.question: We usually have a team building activity ______ the end of each quarter, and this time we'll meet ______ the airport ______ 8 p.m. to take the flight.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配at the end of（在……末尾）；小地点（the airport）前用at；具体时刻（8 p.m.）前用at，三处均符合介词用法。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见固定搭配：at the beginning of（在……开始）、in the middle of（在……中间）、on the edge of（在……边缘）。

questions.question: The art exhibition will open on next Monday and last for three weeks. You can visit it in the afternoon or on night.
questions.explanation: next Monday前不加介词on（this/next/last+时间词前通常省略介词）；“在晚上”固定搭配为at night，不能用on night，题干存在两处错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: this/that/next/last+week/month/year/Monday等时间词前，无需加介词（如this Friday/last month）。

questions.question: The ancient temple is located ______ the top of the mountain, and there is a stone path ______ the village ______ the temple.
questions.explanation: “在山顶”用on the top of（表面之上）；固定搭配from...to...（从……到……），表“从村庄到寺庙的石径”；between...and...表“两者之间”，不符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 表示“在……顶部/表面”用on（如on the table/on the wall）；表示“在……内部/小地点”用at（如at the foot of the mountain）。

questions.question: He works in a small office on the third floor of the building, and he usually has lunch at the restaurant next to his company.
questions.explanation: “在办公室里”用in；“在楼层上”用on；“在餐厅（小地点）”用at，三处介词搭配均正确，语义逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 楼层、街道表面用on（on the second floor/on Main Street）；建筑物内部用in（in the building/in the room）。

questions.question: The meeting will be held ______ 2 p.m. ______ 4 p.m. ______ Wednesday, and all participants are required to be present ______ time.
questions.explanation: from...to...表“从……到……”（时间段范围）；具体星期（Wednesday）前用on；固定搭配on time（准时），in time表“及时”，不符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: between...and...也可表时间段，但侧重“两者之间的任意时间”，from...to...侧重“连续的时间段”，此处会议是连续时长，用from...to...更合适。

questions.question: They arrived at New York on last Friday, and checked into a hotel in the center of the city.
questions.explanation: 大地点（New York）前用in，不能用at；last Friday前不加on，题干存在两处介词错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 国家、城市等大地点前用in（in China/in London）；车站、机场、餐厅等小地点前用at（at the station/at the café）。

questions.question: ______ the morning of June 1st, we will hold a celebration for the children, and ______ noon we will have a picnic ______ the park.
questions.explanation: 具体日期的上午（the morning of June 1st）前用on；固定搭配at noon（在中午）；“在公园（大地点）”前用in，符合规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 泛指“在上午/下午/晚上”用in the morning/afternoon/evening；特指“某一天的上午/下午/晚上”用on（如on a rainy afternoon）。

questions.question: The library is open from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays, and you can borrow books for up to three weeks in the self-service machine.
questions.explanation: “在自助机器上”用on the self-service machine（表面之上），不能用in，题干介词搭配错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 在机器、设备、网络平台等表面/载体上，用on（如on the computer/on the phone/on the Internet）。

questions.question: She has been studying abroad ______ 2021, and she will return to her hometown ______ next year. During her stay, she lived ______ a small town near London.
questions.explanation: since+过去时间点（2021），表“从2021年至今”；next year前省略介词；“在小镇（大地点）”前用in，for+时间段（如for 3 years），不符合此处语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: since表“自从……以来”，后接过去时间点或从句；for表“持续……时间”，后接时间段，两者均用于完成时态。

questions.question: The train departs at 7:30 a.m. from Beijing Station and arrives in Shanghai at 3:15 p.m. You need to arrive at the station in advance to go through security.
questions.explanation: “从某站出发”用depart from；“到达大地点（Shanghai）”用arrive in；“到达小地点（the station）”用arrive at；固定搭配in advance（提前），所有介词均使用正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: arrive in+大地点（国家、城市），arrive at+小地点（车站、机场、学校）；depart from+出发地，depart for+目的地。

questions.question: The accident happened ______ a rainy night ______ the corner of Main Street and Fifth Avenue. A witness was standing ______ the bus stop when it occurred.
questions.explanation: 特指“下雨的夜晚”用on a rainy night；“在街角（小地点）”用at the corner；“在公交站（小地点）”用at the bus stop，符合规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 被形容词修饰的morning/afternoon/evening/night前，用on（如on a cold winter morning/on a quiet night）。

questions.question: We will have a test in next week, and the results will be announced on three days. You can check your score on the school website.
questions.explanation: next week前不加in；“三天后”表将来，用in three days，不能用on three days，题干存在两处介词错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “in+时间段”表“多久之后”，用于将来时（如in five minutes）；“on+时间段”无此用法，具体日期前才用on。

questions.question: The museum displays valuable artifacts ______ the Ming Dynasty, and most of them were discovered ______ a village ______ southern China.
questions.explanation: “来自明朝的文物”用from the Ming Dynasty；“在村庄（大地点）”用in；“在中国南部”用in southern China，of表“所属”，不符合“来自”的语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 表示“来自某时代/地方”用from（如products from Japan）；表示“某地方的一部分”用in（如in northern China）。

questions.question: He spent his childhood in a small village on the countryside, and he often played with friends at the river bank after school.
questions.explanation: “在乡下”固定搭配为in the countryside，不能用on；“在河岸上”用on the river bank，题干第一处介词错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见固定地点搭配：in the city（在城市）、in the countryside（在乡下）、on the coast（在海岸）、at the seaside（在海边）。

questions.question: The lecture about environmental protection will start ______ 3 p.m. ______ Thursday, and it will be delivered ______ the lecture hall ______ the university.
questions.explanation: 具体时刻（3 p.m.）前用at；具体星期（Thursday）前用on；“在演讲厅（内部）”用in；“在大学（大地点）”用in，符合所有搭配规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 建筑物内部用in（in the classroom/in the hospital）；建筑物本身或小地点用at（at the school gate/at the hospital）。

questions.question: They plan to travel to Europe in summer vacation and visit countries like France, Germany and Italy. They will stay in Paris for three days.
questions.explanation: “在暑假”固定搭配为on summer vacation或during the summer vacation，不能用in summer vacation，题干介词搭配错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “在假期”的常见表达：on vacation/on holiday（美式）、during the vacation（通用），in+假期无此搭配。

questions.question: There is a big poster ______ the wall ______ the entrance of the shopping mall, and it advertises a sale that will last ______ the end of the month.
questions.explanation: “在墙上（表面）”用on；“在入口（小地点）”用at；until the end of the month（直到月底），表时间段终点，to the end of需搭配from，不符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: on用于物体表面（墙、纸、桌子等），in用于物体内部（盒子、房间等）；until表“直到……为止”，to表“到……”，需结合语境选择。

questions.question: The concert will be held at the stadium in Saturday evening, and tickets will go on sale at 10 a.m. on tomorrow.
questions.explanation: “在周六晚上”用on Saturday evening，不能用in；tomorrow前不加on，题干存在两处介词错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 具体某一天的晚上用on，泛指晚上用in；this/that/next/last/tomorrow/yesterday等时间词前，均省略介词。
